title: Kerala Police issues advisory against financial fraud using fake customer care numbers
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — INDIA
verified_by: The Hindu bureau report, article fetched and fact-matched 2026-10-02
bullets_en: Kerala Police warned of fraud via fake customer care numbers found online.
Victims call these numbers; fraudsters ring back posing as company agents.
People are tricked into installing remote-access apps and paying fake fees.
Police: use only official apps or websites. Cyber helpline: 1930.
bullets_ur: Kerala Police ne naqli customer care numbers se hone wale cyber dhoke se mehfooz rehne ka mashwara diya.
Ye numbers internet par post kiye jaate hain; dhokebaaz wapas call karke agent bankar baat karte hain.
Log remote-access apps install karke naqli 'registration fees' bhej kar loot liye jaate hain.
Police ka mashwara: sirf official website ya app istemal karein; cyber helpline 1930.
